sanskrit: asāvi devaṃ goṛjīkam andho ny asminn indro januṣem uvoca | bodhāmasi tvā haryaśva yajñair bodhā naḥ stomam andhasō madeṣu ||
english: The divine, strength-giving soma-juice has been pressed; in this very pressing Indra has spoken from birth. We invoke thee, O Haryaśva, with sacrifices; be wakeful of our hymn in the raptures of the soma.

sanskrit: pra yanti yajñaṃ vipayanti barhiḥ somamādo vidathe dudhravācaḥ | ny u bhriyante yaśaso gṛbhād ā dūraüpabdo vṛṣaṇo nṛṣācaḥ ||
english: They who are exhilarated by soma, the loud-voiced ones, advance the sacrifice and spread the sacred grass at the assembly. The bulls who attend men, whose approach is heard from afar, are installed in the seat of glory.

sanskrit: tvam indra sravitavā apas kaḥ pariṣṭhitāḥ ahinā śūra pūrvīḥ | tvad vāvakre rathyo na dhenā rejante viśvā kṛtrimāṇi bhīṣā ||
english: Thou, O Indra, art he who set the waters flowing — the many that had been hemmed in by the serpent, O hero. From thee, as from a coursing mare in a chariot-race, all created things tremble in awe.

sanskrit: bhīmo viveṣāyudhebhir eṣām apāṃsi viśvā naryāṇi vidvān | indraḥ puro jarhṛṣāṇo vi dūdhod vi vajrahasto mahinā jaghāna ||
english: Terrible, attacking with his weapons, knowing all their manly deeds, Indra, exulting, shook the fortresses, and with the bolt in his hand smote them asunder with his greatness.

sanskrit: na yātava indra jūjuvur no na vandanā śaviṣṭha vedyābhiḥ | sa śardhad aryo viṣuṇasya jantor mā śiśnadevā api gur ṛtaṃ naḥ ||
english: The sorcerers, O Indra, have not prevailed against us; nor have obeisances availed the worshipper, O most mighty. He, the Ārya, shall rout the creature of alien race. Let not the phallus-worshippers approach our sacred rite.

sanskrit: abhi kratvendra bhūr adha jman na te vivyaṅ mahimānaṃ rajāṃsi | svenā hi vṛtraṃ śavasā jaghantha na śatrur antaṃ vividad yudhā te ||
english: By thy power, O Indra, thou art present here on earth; the regions could not contain thy greatness. For thou slewest Vṛtra by thine own might and valour, and no foe has ever found the limit of thy battle-strength.

sanskrit: devāś cit te asuryāya pūrve 'nu kṣatrāya mamire sahāṃsi | indro maghāni dayate viṣahyendraṃ vājasya johuvanta sātau ||
english: Even the gods of old accorded their powers to thee for thy lordly sway and dominion. Indra distributes the prizes as he wills; they call upon Indra at the winning of the spoil.

sanskrit: kīriś cid dhi tvām avase juhāveśānam indra saubhagasya bhūreḥ | avo babhūtha śatamūte asme abhikṣattus tvāvato varūtā ||
english: Even the man of small praise has invoked thee for protection, O lord of abundant blessings, O Indra. Thou hast been our refuge, O thou of a hundred aids; the shelter of one like thee is a mighty shield for the suppliant.

sanskrit: sakhāyas ta indra viśvaha syāma namovṛdhāso mahinā tarutra | vanvantu smā te 'vasā samīke 'bhītim aryo vanuṣāṃ śavāṃsi ||
english: May we ever be thy friends, O Indra, reverencing thee with offerings, victorious through thy greatness. With thy aid may they overcome in conflict the onslaughts of the foe who would oppress us.

sanskrit: sa na indra tvayatāyā iṣe dhās tmanā ca ye maghavāno junanti | vasvī ṣu te jaritre astu śaktir yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Do thou, O Indra, grant us the strength of thy bounty, and to those who themselves exert their powers as Maghavans. May thy power as lord of wealth be with thy worshipper; do ye always guard us with blessings.

sanskrit: pibā somam indra mandatu tvā yaṃ te suṣāva haryaśvādriḥ | sotur bāhubhyāṃ suyato nārvā ||
english: Drink the soma, O Indra; let it gladden thee — that which the stone, O Haryaśva, hath well pressed for thee; well-yoked is the bay-stallion by the arms of the presser.

sanskrit: yas te mado yujyaś cārur asti yena vṛtrāṇi haryaśva haṃsi | sa tvām indra prabhūvaso mamattu ||
english: That exhilaration of thine which is fitting and lovely, wherewith thou slayest the Vṛtras, O Haryaśva — may that intoxication, O Indra, overwhelm thee, O lord of abundant wealth.

sanskrit: bodhā su me maghavan vācam emāṃ yāṃ te vasiṣṭho arcati praśastim | imā brahma sadhamāde juṣasva ||
english: Take heed, O Maghavan, to this my speech — the praise that Vasiṣṭha sings to thee. Be pleased with these prayers in the common joy of the soma feast.

sanskrit: śrudhī havaṃ vipipānasyādrer bodhā viprasya arcato manīṣām | kṛṣvā duvāṃsy antamā sacemā ||
english: Hear thou the invocation of the stone that has drunk deep; attend to the devotion of the inspired singer as he chants. Come, perform the nearest services and be our companion.

sanskrit: na te giro api mṛṣye turasya na suṣṭutim asuryasya vidvān | sadā te nāma svayaśo vivakmi ||
english: I do not disregard thy songs, knowing thine eager speed; nor do I disregard the praise of thee who art the lord of might. I ever speak thy name that is self-glorious.

sanskrit: bhūri hi te savanā māṇuṣeṣu bhūri manīṣī havate tvām it | māre asman maghavañ jyok kaḥ ||
english: For many are thy soma-pressings among men; many a sage invokes thee, thee alone. Be not far from us for long, O Maghavan.

sanskrit: tubhyed imā savanā śūra viśvā tubhyam brahmāṇi vardhanā kṛṇomi | tvaṃ nṛbhir havyo viśvadhāsi ||
english: For thee are all these soma-pressings, O hero; for thee I offer prayers that augment thee. Thou art invoked by men and art the sustainer of all.

sanskrit: nū cin nu te manyamānasya dasmad aśnuvanti mahimānam ugra | na vīryam indra te na rādhaḥ ||
english: Now indeed no one can fully comprehend thy greatness, O wonderful and fierce one who deems himself such. Thy heroic might, O Indra, and thy bounty are without limit.

sanskrit: ye ca pūrva ṛṣayo ye ca nūtnā indra brahmāṇi janayanta viprāḥ | asme te santu sakhyā śivāni yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: The seers of former times and they of the present, the inspired priests who have generated prayers for thee, O Indra — may thy auspicious friendships be with us. Do ye always guard us with blessings.

sanskrit: ud u brahmāṇy airata śravasyendraṃ samarye mahayā vasiṣṭha | ā yo viśvāni śavasā tatānopāśrotā ma īvato vacāṃsi ||
english: Rise up, O prayers, for glory's sake; glorify Indra in the battle, O Vasiṣṭha — he who has spread out all things by his might. He shall incline his ear to my living words.

sanskrit: ayāmi ghoṣa indra devajāmir irajyanta yac churudho vivāci | nahi svam āyuś cikite janeṣu tānīd aṃhāṃsy ati parṣy asmān ||
english: I pour forth the shout, O Indra, born among the gods; let my poured speech resound as the bright ones desire. For the span of one's own life is not perceived among men — yet do thou carry us past those very difficulties.

sanskrit: yuje rathaṃ gaveṣaṇaṃ haribhyām upa brahmāṇi jujuṣāṇam asthuḥ | vi bādhiṣṭa sya rodasī mahitvendra vṛtrāṇy apratī jaghanvān ||
english: I yoke the chariot that seeks cattle with the two bays; they have taken their stand beside the prayers with delight. Indra in his greatness has spread apart the two worlds; he has slain the Vṛtras that stood against him.

sanskrit: āpaś cit pipyuḥ staryo na gāvo nakṣann ṛtaṃ jaritāras ta indra | yāhi vāyur na niyuto no acchā tvaṃ hi dhībhir dayase vi vājān ||
english: Even the waters swelled full like cows that had not been milked; thy worshippers have striven towards the sacred order, O Indra. Come to us as Vāyu with his team; for thou by thy wisdom distributest the prizes.

sanskrit: te tvā madā indra mādayantu śuṣmiṇaṃ tuvirādhasaṃ jaritre | eko devatrā dayase hi martān asmiñ chūra savane mādayasva ||
english: May those intoxications gladden thee, O Indra, vigorous one of abundant gifts, for the singer. For thou alone among the gods dost apportion men's fates; rejoice, O hero, at this pressing.

sanskrit: eved indraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhuṃ vasiṣṭhāso abhy arcanty arkaiḥ | sa naḥ stuto vīravad dhātu gomad yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Thus do the Vasiṣṭhas sing their hymns to Indra the bull, the wielder of the bolt. Praised thus, may he grant us wealth in heroes and in cattle. Do ye always guard us with blessings.

sanskrit: yoniṣ ṭa indra sadane akāri tam ā nṛbhiḥ puruhūta pra yāhi | aso yathā no vitā vṛdhe ca dado vasūni mamadaś ca somaiḥ ||
english: A seat, O Indra, has been prepared for thee in the hall of rite; come hither to it with thy escort, O thou much-invoked. Be thou our protector and increaser; grant us riches, and be exhilarated with the soma-draughts.

sanskrit: gṛbhītaṃ te mana indra dvibarhāḥ sutaḥ somaḥ pariṣiktā madhūni | visṛṣṭadhenā bharate suvṛktir iyam indraṃ johuvāti manīṣā ||
english: Thy mind has been seized, O Indra of double might; the soma is pressed, the sweet juices are poured around. This fair-fashioned devotion, whose stream of praise is freely flowing, invokes Indra with longing.

sanskrit: ā no diva ā pṛthivyā ṛjīṣinn idam barhiḥ somapeyāya yāhi | vahantu tvā harayo madryañcam āṅgūṣam acchā tavasam madāya ||
english: Come, O Ṛjīṣin, from heaven and from earth to this sacred grass for the drinking of soma. May the bay steeds bring thee, who desirest exhilaration, towards our hymn of praise, O mighty one, for the joy of drinking.

sanskrit: ā no viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ sajoṣā brahma juṣāṇo haryaśva yāhi | varīvṛjat sthāvirebhiḥ suśiprāsme dadhad vṛṣaṇaṃ śuṣmam indra ||
english: Come to us, O Haryaśva, enjoying all our aids together, pleased with our prayer. Come, O fine-jawed Indra, striding mightily with thy stalwart steps, laying upon us the manly vigour of the bull.

sanskrit: eṣa stomo maha ugrāya vāhe dhurīvātyo na vājayann adhāyi | indra tvāyam arka īṭṭe vasūnāṃ divīva dyām adhi naḥ śromataṃ dhāḥ ||
english: This hymn has been fashioned for the great and fierce one, to be borne on the yoke-pole like a swift charger straining for the prize. This song invokes thee, O Indra, for the winning of wealth; grant us distinction above others as the sky is above heaven.

sanskrit: evā na indra vāryasya pūrdhi pra te mahīṃ sumatiṃ vevidāma | iṣam pinva maghavadbhyaḥ suvīrāṃ yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Thus, O Indra, fill us with the choicest treasure; we have sought thy great benevolence. Bestow on the Maghavans refreshment rich in heroes. Do ye always guard us with blessings.

sanskrit: ā te maha indro ty ugra samanyavo yat samaranta senāḥ | patāti didyun naryasya bāhvor mā te mano viṣvadryag vi cārit ||
english: Great Indra comes, O fierce one, when in equal fury the armies clash together in battle. The lightning-bolt flies from the arms of the manly god; let not thy mind wander in all directions.

sanskrit: ni durga indra śnathihy amitrān abhi ye no martāso amanti | āre taṃ śaṃsaṃ kṛṇuhi ninitsor ā no bhara sambharaṇaṃ vasūnām ||
english: O Indra, smite down into the abyss the enemies, the mortal men who assail us. Make the hostile incitement of the plotter to be far away; bring to us the gathering of riches.

sanskrit: śataṃ te śiprinn ūtayaḥ sudāse sahasraṃ śaṃsā uta rātir astu | jahi vadhar vanuṣo martyasyāsme dyumnam adhi ratnaṃ ca dhehi ||
english: Hundredfold, O Śiprin, be thy aids to Sudās; a thousandfold may thy praises and gifts be. Strike down the weapon of the mortal foe; lay upon us splendour and treasure.

sanskrit: tvāvato hīndra kratve asmi tvāvato vituḥ śūra rātau | viśved ahāni taviṣīva ugram okaḥ kṛṇuṣva harivo na mardhīḥ ||
english: For such a one as thee, O Indra, I exist in intelligence; for such a one as thee, O hero, in the bestowal of gifts. With vigour fiercely throughout all the days, O Harivaṇ, make thy dwelling with us; neglect us not.

sanskrit: kutsā ete haryaśvāya śūṣam indre saho devajūtam iyānāḥ | satrā kṛdhi suhanā śūra vṛtrā vayaṃ tarutrāḥ sanuyāma vājam ||
english: These praises of the Kutsa clan move toward Indra the Haryaśva seeking vigour, seeking god-sped might. Make the Vṛtras altogether easy to smite, O hero; may we as victors win the prize.

sanskrit: evā na indra vāryasya pūrdhi pra te mahīṃ sumatiṃ vevidāma | iṣam pinva maghavadbhyaḥ suvīrāṃ yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Thus, O Indra, fill us with the choicest treasure; we have sought thy great benevolence. Bestow on the Maghavans refreshment rich in heroes. Do ye always guard us with blessings.

sanskrit: na soma indram asuto mamāda nābrahmaṇo maghavānaṃ sutāsaḥ | tasmā ukthaṃ janaye yaj jujoṣan nṛvan navīyaḥ śṛṇavad yathā naḥ ||
english: Without pressed soma Indra has not been exhilarated; without prayer have the pressed libations not exhilarated Maghavan. Therefore I generate a hymn, that as he has taken pleasure therein, the hero may hear our newer song.

sanskrit: uktha-ukthe soma indram mamāda nīthe-nīthe maghavānaṃ sutāsaḥ | yad īṃ sabādhaḥ pitaraṃ na putrāḥ samānadakṣā avase havante ||
english: With hymn after hymn, with pressed soma after pressed soma, Maghavan has been exhilarated. When men of equal will and vigour, hard-pressed like sons invoking a father, call on Indra for aid.

sanskrit: cakāra tā kṛṇavan nūnam anyā yāni bruvanti vedhāsaḥ suteṣu | janīr iva patir ekaḥ samāno ni māmṛje pura indraḥ su sarvāḥ ||
english: He has done these deeds, now making others that the priests speak of at the soma-pressings. Like a single husband ruling over wives, Indra has well cleansed all the cities.

sanskrit: evā tam āhur uta śṛṇva indra eko vibhaktā taraṇir maghānām | mithastura ūtayo yasya pūrvīr asme bhadrāṇi saścata priyāṇi ||
english: Thus they speak of him; and hear, O Indra — thou art the sole distributor, the speedy apportioner of prizes. His many aids are for mutual protection; may his auspicious blessings follow after us as beloved gifts.

sanskrit: evā vasiṣṭha indram ūtaye nṝn kṛṣṭīnāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ sute gṛṇāti | sahasriṇa upa no māhi vājān yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Thus does Vasiṣṭha praise Indra, the bull of the tribes, at the soma-pressing, for the welfare of men. Bring thousandfold prizes near to us. Do ye always guard us with blessings.

sanskrit: indraṃ naro nemadhitā havante yat pāryā yunajate dhiyas tāḥ | śūro nṛṣātā śavasaś cakāna ā gomati vraje bhajā tvaṃ naḥ ||
english: Men call on Indra with reverence, when they harness those thoughts that are to reach their goal. The hero who prostrates men, who delights in his own might — allot us our share in the cow-stall that yields cattle.

sanskrit: ya indra śuṣmo maghavan te asti śikṣā sakhibhyaḥ puruhūta nṛbhyaḥ | tvaṃ hi dṛḻhā maghavan vicetā apā vṛdhi parivṛtaṃ na rādhaḥ ||
english: Whatever vigour is thine, O Maghavan, share it with thy friends, O much-invoked, with the heroes. For thou, O Maghavan, art the discerning one; release our bounty that is locked away, like water held back.

sanskrit: indro rājā jagataś carṣaṇīnām adhi kṣami viṣurūpaṃ yad asti | tato dadāti dāśuṣe vasūni codad rādha upastutaś cid arvāk ||
english: Indra is king of the moving world, of all peoples, over the earth, whatever there is of manifold form. From that position he gives riches to the worshipper, he who is praised stimulates bounty to flow hither.

sanskrit: nū cin na indro maghavā sahūtī dāno vājaṃ ni yamate na ūtī | anūnā yasya dakṣiṇā pīpāya vāmaṃ nṛbhyo abhivītā sakhibhyaḥ ||
english: Indra the Maghavan, when invoked together with us, shall in no way hold back the prize for giving, nor his aid. His bounteous gift — he whose south-offering has swelled to fullness — flows towards good things for the heroes and friends.

sanskrit: nū indra rāye varivas kṛdhī na ā te mano vavṛtyāma maghāya | gomad aśvāvad rathavad vyanto yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Now, O Indra, grant us wide room for wealth; we would turn thy mind towards our bounty. May we go forth rich in cattle, horses, and chariots. Do ye always guard us with blessings.

sanskrit: brahmā ṇa indropa yāhi vidvān arvāñcas te harayaḥ santu yuktāḥ | viśve cid dhi tvā vihavanta martā asmākam ic chṛṇuhi viśvaminva ||
english: Come to us with the prayer, O Indra, O wise one; let thy bay steeds be turned hither and yoked. For indeed all mortals call upon thee; hear us, O thou who fillest all.

sanskrit: havaṃ ta indra mahimā vy ānaḍ brahma yat pāsi śavasinn ṛṣīṇām | ā yad vajraṃ dadhiṣe hasta ugra ghoraḥ san kratvā janiṣṭhā aṣāḻhaḥ ||
english: Thy greatness, O Indra, has answered our invocation when thou dost protect the prayer of the seers, O mighty one. When thou takest the bolt in thy hand, O terrible one, grim as thou art, thou wast born unconquerable by thy wisdom.

sanskrit: tava praṇītīndra johuvānān saṃ yan nṝn na rodasī ninetha | mahe kṣatrāya śavase hi jajñe 'tūtujiṃ cit tūtujir aśiśnat ||
english: Those who call upon thee under thy guidance, O Indra, thou dost lead — just as thou dost lead together the two worlds and the men. For thou wast born for great dominion and might; the urger destroyed even the one who was not swift to urge.

sanskrit: ebhir na indrāhabhir daśasya durmitrāso hi kṣitayaḥ pavante | prati yac caṣṭe anṛtam anenā ava dvitā varuṇo māyī naḥ sāt ||
english: With these days be gracious to us, O Indra; for the ill-friended peoples hasten away. Since the blameless one sees the falsehood directly, may deceitful Varuṇa turn away from us once and for all.

sanskrit: vocemed indram maghavānam enam maho rāyo rādhaso yad dadan naḥ | yo arcato brahmakṛtim aviṣṭho yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: We would proclaim this Indra Maghavan for what he grants us of great wealth and bounty — he who protects the inspired singer's prayer of the one who sings. Do ye always guard us with blessings.

sanskrit: ayaṃ soma indra tubhyaṃ sunva ā tu pra yāhi harivastaḥ dokāḥ | pibā tv asya suṣutasya cāror dado maghāni maghavann iyānaḥ ||
english: This soma, O Indra, is pressed for thee; come hither, O Harivaṇ who dwellest at home. Drink then of this well-pressed, lovely draught, coming to give us prizes, O Maghavan.

sanskrit: brahman vīra brahmaḥkṛtiṃ juṣāṇo 'rvācīno haribhir yāhi tūyam | asminn ū ṣu savane mādayasv opa brahmāṇi śṛṇava imā naḥ ||
english: O Brāhmaṇ hero, be pleased with the prayer's fashioning; come swiftly hither with the bay steeds. Be exhilarated at this soma-pressing; hear these our prayers.

sanskrit: kā te asty araṃkṛtiḥ sūktaiḥ kadā nūnaṃ te maghavan dāśema | viśvā matīr ā tatane tvāyā dhā ma indra śṛṇavo havemā ||
english: What adornment of thee is there with well-spoken hymns? When, O Maghavan, shall we make offering to thee? I have stretched forth all thoughts towards thee; set, O Indra, so that thou mayest hear when we invoke thee.

sanskrit: uto ghā te puruṣyā id āsan yeṣāṃ pūrveṣām aśṛṇor ṛṣīṇām | adhāhaṃ tvā maghavañ johavīmi tvaṃ na indrāsi pramatiḥ piteva ||
english: And indeed those men of thine have existed — the seers of former times to whom thou didst hearken. And so I keep calling upon thee, O Maghavan; thou, O Indra, art our guardian as a father.

sanskrit: vocemed indram maghavānam enam maho rāyo rādhaso yad dadan naḥ | yo arcato brahmakṛtim aviṣṭho yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: We would proclaim this Indra Maghavan for what he grants us of great wealth and bounty — he who protects the inspired singer's prayer of the one who sings. Do ye always guard us with blessings.

sanskrit: ā no deva śavasā yāhi śuṣmin bhavā vṛdha indra rāyo asya | mahe nṛmṇāya nṛpate suvajra mahi kṣatrāya pauṃsyāya śūra ||
english: Come to us, O divine Indra, with might, thou vigorous one; be thou the increaser of this our wealth. Come for great manly strength, O lord of men who wieldest the good bolt, come for great dominion and vigour, O hero.

sanskrit: havanta u tvā havyaṃ vivāci tanūṣu śūrāḥ sūryasya sātau | tvaṃ viśveṣu senyo janeṣu tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi randhayā suhantu ||
english: The heroes call upon thee, calling thee with distinct voice in their own persons at the winning of the sun. Thou art to be called upon as a warrior among all peoples; cause the Vṛtras to yield — let them be easy to smite.

sanskrit: ahā yad indra sudinā vyucchān dadho yat ketum upamaṃ samatsu | ny agniḥ sīdad asuro na hotā huvāno atra subhagāya devān ||
english: When, O Indra, thou hast shone forth in fair days illuminating, when thou dost plant the highest banner in battles — Agni takes his seat as the divine Ṛtvik-priest, inviting the gods here for the sake of blessedness.

sanskrit: vayaṃ te ta indra ye ca deva stavanta śūra dadato maghāni | yacchā sūribhya upamaṃ varūthaṃ svābhuvo jaraṇām aśnavanta ||
english: We, and those gods too, O hero Indra, who praise thee the giver of prizes — grant to the pious patrons the highest protection, so that those born of good stock may attain to long old age.

sanskrit: vocemed indram maghavānam enam maho rāyo rādhaso yad dadan naḥ | yo arcato brahmakṛtim aviṣṭho yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: We would proclaim this Indra Maghavan for what he grants us of great wealth and bounty — he who protects the inspired singer's prayer of the one who sings. Do ye always guard us with blessings.
